title: Enterprise Service Request Triage Output
description: Strict structured response produced by triage prompts. Machine-consumed; no text may appear outside this object.

request_id.description: Echoes the request identifier supplied in the input. MUST NOT be invented; use the exact supplied value.

summary.description: Concise description of the issue grounded in the supplied request.

recommended_action.description: Specific next action. MUST NOT claim an action was already performed.

missing_information.description: Items of missing information. Empty array when nothing is missing.

evidence.description: Evidence taken only from the supplied request or policy. Empty array when no supporting evidence exists.

confidence.description: Model-reported confidence in the triage decision.

needs_human_review.description: MUST be true when critical information is missing, sources conflict, policy support is insufficient, the request suggests a security incident, or the category cannot be reliably determined.
